# obsidian-llm-translate

> An Obsidian plugin that translates selected text or whole notes with LLMs (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, and any OpenAI-compatible provider), with streaming output and frontmatter preservation.

obsidian-llm-translate lets you translate English articles, notes, or clippings into any language directly inside Obsidian using your own LLM API key.
It supports streaming output so you see the translation appear in real time, preserves YAML frontmatter on full-note translation, and lets you cancel mid-stream.
Nine provider presets (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, Doubao, Kimi, Qwen, Zhipu, SiliconFlow, OpenRouter) plus a custom endpoint option cover virtually any OpenAI-compatible API.
